name: RankmyAI

sources.title: Tool addition form — free inclusion, full field list, 'Tools must have a dedicated website or subdomain and a significant AI component'; review up to 7 days

requirements: Tool must have a dedicated website or subdomain
Tool must have a significant AI component
Inclusion is at their discretion — this is a ranked database (overall/traffic/investment/review rankings), not an open posting board
Requires company details: legal name, HQ address (country/state/city/street/postal), founding year, employee count
preparation: Use cases ≤300 chars and a short description ≤400 chars
Product Hunt profile link if one exists (optional field)
Company data: legal name, company website, LinkedIn URL, year founded, employee count, full HQ address
Pricing label (Paid/Freemium/Free, ≤15 chars), pricing page URL, API availability (Yes/No)
workflow: Fill all required fields plus optional company/Product Hunt details — richer data feeds their ranking and map features
Submit and wait; the form states 'Review may take up to 7 days. You'll always hear from us.'
After inclusion, the tool appears in the database and becomes eligible for category and top-100 rankings
watchFor: Deep company-data ask (full HQ street address) unusual for a free listing — share only accurate public company info
Dutch academic-affiliated project (part of HvA, CC BY 4.0 licensed data) — listings feed research, not marketing pages
Ranking placement is data-driven; a bare listing may rank low without traffic/review signals
countsAsLive: The tool has a profile in the RankmyAI database and is discoverable via their rankings/maps/search
unknowns: Whether tool profiles carry outbound followed links
How rankings weight newly added tools with no traffic history
Whether there is any paid fast-track (none was visible on the form)
